opening.argument: The video presents an unusually high return claim: “In a week on the commissions revenue was $8 or about 70% annually.” It directly links obtaining that commission revenue to supplying liquidity in equal proportions of MATIC and USDT: “half of the MATIC tokens, half of the USDT tokens.” The visible Uniswap V3 Matic liquidity-pool screen, with separate Deposited and Earned rows for both assets, reinforces that this is a participation-and-return mechanism rather than general commentary alone. The short review framing and visible “Подпишись” prompt do not make channel engagement a stated condition for participating. The display does not independently verify the result or establish that the rate is guaranteed, but the combination of an approximately 70% annualized figure and a required liquidity contribution supports treating the presentation as an investment-pool or staking-return solicitation.
